01 / About

A curious mind,
an applied approach.

I'm interested in the space where software engineering, data, and research meet. I like building tools around real workflows, then digging into the deeper questions those tools reveal.

At Waterloo, I am developing my technical foundation while exploring research opportunities. My recent work spans a research outreach tracker, an early stage internship workflow app, and questions about how AI agent skills are reused and maintained.

03 / Research interests

Questions worth
exploring.

I'm learning how to turn interesting observations into careful, testable research questions.

✳

AI agent skills

How do skills spread across repositories, and how can we understand reuse without mistaking identical content for proof of origin?

⌁

Software quality

What signals help us evaluate the usefulness and maintainability of a skill when there is no single measure of quality?

These are areas of exploration, not claims of published research findings.
